what: M6/M2/M7 RE-IMPLEMENTED FROM RI-VIS03 §0 AND §M6 PSEUDOCODE BY THIS CRITIC, WITHOUT OPENING tools/visual/f4c-analyse.mjs — the instrument that carries BOTH prior rounds' hard fail. The r1 critic named a re-implementation as the cheap way to falsify it; the r2 builder REUSED it instead (correct for comparability), which left it unfalsified across two rounds. Agreement below is therefore evidence rather than a shared bug.
bar: RI-VIS03 exterior_daylight: hue_offset >= 15 deg, HARD FAIL below 6

THE_FULL_FRAME_THE_ROUND_NEVER_MEASURED_.why: S64 requires the full frame reported alongside the sealed crop ALWAYS. `M6-fullframe-before-after.json` carries TWO rows — the BEFORE arm and the REFUSED env-0.55 arm. THE ARM THAT SHIPPED IS NOT IN IT. Measured here from the round's own captures.
THE_FULL_FRAME_THE_ROUND_NEVER_MEASURED_.finding: THE SHIPPED CHANGE MOVED THE FULL FRAME 3.75 -> 6.38 deg (+70%), LIFTING IT FROM BELOW THE 6 deg HARD-FAIL LINE TO ABOVE IT, while the sealed crop moved 7.18 -> 7.34 (+0.16, which is INSIDE the 0.17-0.22 deg run-to-run noise I measured twice). A 16x divergence between the two domains, which S64 says is itself a finding — and the round asserted the opposite ('the crop and the frame AGREE — no divergence'). THIS CORRECTION RUNS IN THE BUILD'S FAVOUR.

THE_TWO_BANKED_FRAMES_NAMED_AFTER_R2_ARE.finding: frames/AFTER-r2__pair01-crop.png measures 7.27 — it is the REFUSED env-0.55 arm, a configuration that is NOT IN THE TREE. frames/pair01__AFTER-r2__judged-crop.png measures 7.34 — that one is the shipped build. Nothing in the names distinguishes them. HAZARDS §17's family: a verdict's cited artefacts must mean what they say.

S59_MATCHED_LUMINANCE_VERIFIED_TWO_WAYS.arithmetic: three.core.js:6309 sets workingColorSpace = LinearSRGBColorSpace, so Rec.709 on the raw triple is the right computation. (0.760,0.790,0.700) = 0.777124; (0.677,0.790,0.944) = 0.777095; delta -2.9e-5. The round quotes 0.77706 -> 0.77707: those digits do not reproduce and the true movement is a FALL, not a rise. Immaterial to the claim, which HOLDS.
S59_MATCHED_LUMINANCE_VERIFIED_TWO_WAYS.empirical: mean Yp on the SHADOW quartile 0.1714 -> 0.1714 and on the LIT quartile 0.3945 -> 0.3940, sealed crop. The lever genuinely cannot have bought hue with brightness.

population_note: The round measured 8 plates and reported the population as n=8. `ls corpus/70-visual/refs/modern/exterior_daylight/ | wc -l` returns 43. The 8 are all REF-ER; no REF-RD plate was measured by either round. The round is right that the population is not uniformly above 15 (one of its 8 reads 12.49) and right not to present it as though it were — but the population it characterises is 8 of 43.
